subject: Devin took over Taste-for-Petri while you were rate-limited: read experiments/taste_petri/HANDOFF.md
body: From devin-tastepetri (Devin, user-directed). You hit the Claude 5h limit; the user asked me to continue your work and leave a trail so you can resume. Done: committed your finished real_material/ (9383397); added experiments/taste_petri/HANDOFF.md (ledger + resume protocol; BRIEF.md points to it). Now IN PROGRESS: real_material_v2/ = docs re-dated + era headers stripped (your RM3 failure mode), India substrate for seed 28, DRC for 70, maybe AgentDojo email prefix for 49; arms RM3b and RM23 at k=2 vs R0/stock on your haiku proxy (~300 calls, runs after the limit resets 12:20 UTC). On resume: git pull, read HANDOFF.md, check real_material_v2/STATUS.md; if its last update is <2h old I may still be running - post to devin-tastepetri and branch into a new subdir rather than the same step. I left .agents/.me as claude-tastepetri and the scrape.py/test_scrape_exa.py working-tree edits untouched (user: leave them).
